intro.en: Weddings, traditions, beliefs, and the vocabulary of a popular festival.

texto.en:
Many towns in Spain celebrate local **fiestas populares**; some are connected with a patron saint. A celebration may include **un desfile** or **una procesión**, **música**, **fuegos artificiales** or food in the street. In **Carnaval**, people **se disfrazan de** different characters. Traditions vary from place to place.

A wedding: **la despedida de soltero** or **de soltera**, **la boda** (civil or religiosa), **el banquete**, **la luna de miel**. You **felicitas a** the couple: **¡Enhorabuena! ¡Que seáis muy felices!**

Presents: **envolver**, **abrir** or **hacer un regalo**.

Beliefs: **ser creyente**, **ser ateo**, **ir a misa**, **rezar**. In Spain, some people associate **martes y trece** with bad luck.

Describe customs with **soler** or **se + verb**: **Se suele** cenar tarde; **es costumbre** dar dos besos; **es típico** + infinitive.

frases.es: Cada agosto mi pueblo celebra sus fiestas, que duran una semana.
frases.en: Every August my village holds its festival, which lasts a week.

frases.es: El primer día hay un desfile y los niños se disfrazan.
frases.en: On the first day there is a parade and the children dress up.

frases.es: Por la mañana los más creyentes van a misa y luego sale la procesión del santo.
frases.en: In the morning the most religious people go to mass and then the saint's procession comes out.

frases.es: Es costumbre que los vecinos cenen juntos en la calle.
frases.en: It is the custom for neighbours to have dinner together in the street.

frases.es: La última noche se suele bailar hasta que empiezan los fuegos artificiales.
frases.en: On the last night people usually dance until the fireworks start.

frases.es: Mucha gente que vive fuera vuelve al pueblo solo para estos días.
frases.en: Many people who live away come back to the village just for these days.

pregunta.en: Complete: at Carnival I dress up as a pirate.
Complete: it is the custom for neighbours to dine together.

cenen.en: Es costumbre que takes the subjunctive.

cenan.en: After es costumbre que, the subjunctive.

cenar.en: With que you need a conjugated verb.

**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (100–120 words).** Describe a tradition or a superstition from your country and what you think of it.

**Speak (about 2 minutes).** Explain aloud to a foreigner a festival in your country: its origin, what people do and what they eat.
